attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"One in four American households are either unbanked or underbanked, putting them at risk of losing money due to exorbitant fees or usurious interest rates.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support efforts in Congress to guarantee affordable, transparent, and trustworthy banking services that are language-accessible for low- and middle-income families.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support bank accounts and real-time payment systems through the Federal Reserve.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support easily accessible service locations, like postal banking.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Consumers, workers, students, retirees, and investors who have been mistreated by businesses should never be denied their right to fight for fair treatment under the law.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support efforts to eliminate the use of forced arbitration clauses in employment and service contracts.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Forced arbitration clauses unfairly strip consumers, workers, students, retirees, and investors of their right to their day in court.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
